XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Cars fitted with dual-zone automatic climate control

  • System: Climate control

  • Component: Cabin radiator

  • Fault: The vehicle’s cabin heating is not functioning

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty cabin heater

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the cabin radiator; replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the faulty radiator was found to be completely blocked. To resolve the fault permanently, the system was cleaned as well as the radiator being replaced.
    The component in question is located in the passenger compartment, on the centre console, and can be accessed by removing the airbag on the driver’s side, beneath the steering wheel on the right.
